evidence.excerpt: To bridge this gap, we introduce LongHisDoc, the first benchmark tailored for long historical document understanding.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in modern document tasks, their capabilities in Long (full-book) Historical Document understanding remain largely unexplored.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Our evaluation reveals that the top-performing LVLM and LLM achieve only 62.9% and 69.9% accuracy, respectively, highlighting a substantial performance gap.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: LongHisDoc comprises 1,012 expert-annotated QA pairs derived from 101 PDF documents, with an average of 85.1 pages and 42,776.4 tokens per document.
